decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line survived the 2019 pruning and fits the post-pandemic demand for flexible, representative workplaces, so its value is increasingly confirmed and it warrants continued commitment rather than abandonment.

The soft upholstered sofa is close to the core residential range and cheap to keep alongside existing upholstery capabilities, and it survived the 2019 cuts, but its weaker website emphasis leaves a moderate risk that it is folded back into the established collection.
